title: Figure 46: Landing ellipses for Apollo, M2/F2, X-20 DynaSoar, FDL and Model 176 gliders
description: Chart of lateral range versus down range (1000 nautical miles, 0-30) showing nested landing ellipses labeled "Ballistic," "Eggers M-2," "DynaSoar," "Lifting Body," "Model 176B 88% Capability" and "Model 176 B," originating at an "Atmospheric Entry" point at 0,0. Caption: "Figure 46. Landing Ellipses for (from left) Apollo Capsule, NASA Ames M2/F2, USAF X-20 DynaSoar, FDL Lifting-Body, 88%-Capability MDC Model 176H, and MDC 176H." Appears in "Appendix D: Landing Ellipses for Hypersonic Gliders."
